Title: Tamgha-i-Imtiaz for Professor Waqar
NewsSummary: Professor Waqar has received the state honour for his contributions to science
NewsContent:
Professor Mohammad Anwar Waqar, Chairman, Department of Biochemistry, Aga Khan Medical University, Karachi has an international reputation as a highly qualified biochemist. He has been actively involved in biochemical research for the last 26 years. He is a distinguished academician and teacher. He has served on various Committees of the Medical School of the Aga Khan University and is involved in aspects of curriculum design and teaching strategies relevant to a newly established medical college. He is a highly valued and distinguished member of the senior faculty and enjoys peer support at all levels at the Aga Khan University Medical Centre, Karachi. 

He is a member of the Technical Committee for Biological Sciences of the National Scientific Research and Development Board. Pakistan and also a member of the Pakistan Universities Coordination Council and the University Grants Commission. In his capacity as Chairman of the Department of Biochemistry, he has played the pivotal role in the development of research and teaching activities. His on-going research work includes the development of the capability to apply molecular understanding of certain aspects of cellular and viral regulation to therapeutic control of cell growth (in malignant disease) and of virus growth (in viral and malignant disease). 

In recognition of his contribution in the field of science, the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan has been pleased to confer on Professor Mohammad Anwar Waqar, the award of "Tamgha-i Imtiaz", 1991.
